svg.title: Issue 4 — Page 5 — Panel 1: SPLASH. Theodore's face fills the squad's sky through the floorboard gap
svg.desc: 24mm extreme low angle from squad POV looking straight up through floorboard gap. Theodore's monumental face fills the sky, framed by warped floorboard edges. Sandy-brown hair hanging down, wide hazel eyes, freckles, mouth slightly open in held wonder. Below his face, five tiny squad members stand on timber beams looking up. Sable center, defiant, chin raised. Jink slightly apart. Thresh, Wren, Luma arrayed. DUAL LIGHTING: warm grey daylight from above pours through gap onto Theodore. Cool blue-white holographic glow rises from camp below painting underside of floorboards and lower contours of Theodore's face. Theodore: You're all here. You're all... / ...real. Sable: We are real. We are not fairies. We are not magic. And you are not supposed to be here.
svg.text: We are real. We are not fairies. We are not magic.
And you are not supposed to be here.
